name: io.github.flashdata-dev/google-shopping
title: Google Shopping — FlashData
description: Google Shopping product, merchant and price-label snapshots. Paid FlashData API.

environmentVariables.name: FLASHDATA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your FlashData API Key with google_shopping access. Get a key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys; data calls are paid.

dev.flashdata.useResult: Read results[0].shopping. Join a stored prior snapshot by productId or link, then compare the original price strings and retain title, source and captured time.
dev.flashdata.limits: Currency-formatted price labels are not normalized numeric prices. This does not calculate exchange rates or guarantee stock, checkout prices or complete market coverage.
dev.flashdata.installation: Local MCPB / stdio; Node.js >=22.18.0; set your own FLASHDATA_API_KEY in protected client settings. See guideUrl for manual setup.
dev.flashdata.billing: MIT software and installation are free. FlashData data calls use paid Credits. Pricing/job/result reads are free; client and model fees are separate.
